capabilities: Show inline checkbox tasks as rows in a Bases view, with note properties as columns
Display the same tasks as a board grouped by status, priority, due date or urgency
Place tasks on a month or agenda calendar by due, scheduled or start date
Filter, sort and group tasks by task fields or note properties
Tick, edit, add and bulk-change tasks in place with undo
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.13 or newer with the Bases core plugin enabled; on 1.10 to 1.12 only version 1.0.2 runs, with the list view alone. Free, no account, no network requests. Beta builds are installed through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Tasklines adds a view to Bases with one row per checkbox task in the notes a base selects
problem: Inline tasks are buried inside notes, and Bases can only list notes, so there is no table, board or calendar of the individual tasks.

relations.evidence: when the Tasks plugin (7.2.0 or later) is enabled, Tasklines asks it to complete tasks
Convert Dataview task query under cursor to a base

summary: Bases view that shows inline checkbox tasks as a table, board, Eisenhower matrix or calendar, with in-place editing.
